critical_code_review_comments: Reports.jsx is nearing 373 lines with 3 inline table implementations (daily, subject, PersonReport). Consider extracting DailyReport & SubjectReport into their own files to keep single-responsibility (currently mixes 3 report shapes and the tab shell).
PersonReport useEffect deps miss meta.showClass but include it; harmless. Consider passing an AbortController when switching tabs quickly to prevent stale setRows/setRecap after unmount.

Daily table cell uses r.teacher_name for all persons (student/teacher/employee). Currently backend maps name into teacher_name for compat; works but is confusing naming — recommend renaming API field to person_name for clarity.
